description: [CAF] Following the Confédération Africaine de Football ("CAF") Executive Committee's unanimous decision on 29 October 2026 to return to the CAF Africa Cup of Nations ("AFCON") taking place every two years, CAF has issued an Amendment Notice to the Commercial Rights Invitation to Tender ("ITT") published on 23 July 2026, for the appointment of Commercial Rights Partners. The Amendment Notice issued on 2 November confirms the years of the three AFCON editions being tendered for under the ITT.
title: Africa: CAF Amends the Commercial Rights Invitation to Tender for the Lucrative CAF Africa Cup of Nations 2028, 2031 and 2033

description: [263Chat] Discriminatory social norms, unequal power relations and growing gender-based violence continue to undermine women's participation in political leadership across Africa, despite progress in representation and the adoption of laws promoting gender equality, United Nations and European Union officials have warned.
title: Africa: Women Still Shut Out of Power As Gender Bias Undermines Africa's Democracy

description: [Daba Finance] Access Holdings Plc reported its unaudited results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, showing resilient profit growth. The Group's Profit Before Tax increased by 8.3% to ₦667.4 billion. Profit After Tax also rose by 5.9% to ₦474.2 billion during the period.
title: Africa: Access Holdings Reports Strong 9m 2026 Profit Growth

description: [Daba Finance] African-owned mobile game Rise of Fearless has secured $1 million in funding from Dubai-based investment firm Epic Edges Capital. The capital was raised through a Simple Agreement for Future Equity (SAFE) to expand the game's audience and build a commercially sustainable gaming franchise. This investment, announced following an October 27 interview with founder Kanessa Muluneh, comes amid growing investor interest in Africa's gaming industry.
title: Africa: African-Owned Game Rise of Fearless Secures $1m for Expansion

description: [OCHA] (New York, 2 November 2026) The United Nations has launched a first-of-its-kind insurance programme that could unlock up to US$40 million in additional funding to help reach people before they lose their homes, food or livelihoods when multiple disasters threaten at once, putting exceptional pressure on available resources.
title: Africa: UN Launches Insurance Safety Net to Help Protect Families Before Disasters Strike

description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Access to a twice-yearly HIV prevention injection is moving closer to millions of people in low- and middle-income countries after Dr. Reddy's Laboratories secured tentative approval from the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the first generic version of lenacapavir.
title: Africa: Generic HIV Prevention Injection Moves Closer to 120 Countries After FDA Approval

description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The African Union has called on African governments to strengthen mechanisms for protecting journalists and ensure attacks against media workers are investigated and prosecuted, warning that persistent impunity is undermining press freedom and democratic accountability.
title: Africa: AU Urges African Governments to End Impunity for Crimes Against Journalists

description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The World Health Organization (WHO) will convene the first Africa Health Data Forum in Nairobi next week, seeking to strengthen health information systems through country-led priorities, investment and closer coordination among development partners.
title: Africa: WHO Convenes First Africa Health Data Forum in Nairobi to Drive Coordinated Action

description: [RFI] Monday marks the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes Against Journalists - chosen in memory of Ghislaine Dupont and Claude Verlon, two journalists from Radio France Internationale murdered in Mali on 2 November 2013. According to a report by Unesco, attacks and harassment targeting the press continue to go largely unpunished in Africa and across the globe.
title: Africa: Nine Out of Ten Crimes Against Journalists Go Unpunished - Unesco Report

description: [Africa CDC] Kigali, Rwanda -- African Union Member States are a step closer to a coordinated response to non-communicable diseases (NCDs), injuries and mental health conditions following the finalisation of a multisectoral action plan at a five-day technical meeting convened by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC).
title: Africa: New Multisectoral Framework to Cocreate National Multisectoral Action Plan to Improve NCDs, Injuries and Mental Health

description: [This Day] Coronation Group is set to advance discussions on mobilising domestic capital and expanding institutional investors' participation in infrastructure financing at the Africa Financial Summit (AFIS) 2026, as two of its senior executives prepare to share insights on unlocking private investment for the continent's development.
title: Africa: Coronation Pushes Africa's Private Capital, Infrastructure Financing Agenda

description: [Daily Trust] AFLeading voices from government, business, technology, finance and civil society will converge in Abuja on Tuesday for the 2nd edition of the Oxford Global Think Tank (OGTT) Leadership Conference, a high-level gathering focused on charting practical pathways to a more prosperous future for Africa.
title: Africa: African Leaders Converge On Abuja for Leadership Talks

description: [Ghanaian Times] On October 6, 2026, Ghana announced that it would apply to engage with BRICS following Cabinet approval. Six days later, the Foreign Affairs Minister clarified that Ghana was seeking Partner Country status, not full membership. The distinction matters: Ghana is exploring a new avenue for international cooperation, not joining every BRICS institution or automatically gaining access to its benefits.
title: Africa: Ghana's BRIC's Ambition - Why Governance Will Decide the Outcome

description: [Ghanaian Times] Ghana has endorsed calls for structured and good-faith dialogue involving the African Union (AU), the Caribbean Community (CARICOM), the African diaspora and countries involved in the transatlantic slave trade and chattel enslavement.
title: Africa: Apology Without Reparatory Justice Not Enough - Pres Mahama
